source_state: uncommitted shared supplied-request source gateway and native owned/borrowed input handoff
behavior: Supplied request authority reaches the same source scheduler as ordinary unbudgeted execution without creating replacement authority.
Exact execution identity, input/chunk shape, cached frontier and output demand are checked before the semantic source factory.
One-use authority is consumed before source construction; a failed/unavailable source cannot restart from a retention clone or switch to the unquoted fallback.
Owned native input clones and borrowed views preserve the same request and exact chunk geometry.
State retains the charge after caller handles are dropped; cached decode enforces the original allowance and reset releases the charge.
Admitted cancellation commits one completed span, preserves prefix numerics and retains its charge until reset.
Native foreign-target and chunk-mismatch rejection preserve state and permit the correctly admitted request to run.
Existing full/selective, quantized/tied and composite TP/PP regressions pass in the focused architecture suite.
limits: Public facade preparation does not yet obtain a complete quote and reserve it before native input allocation; default public requests remain explicitly unbudgeted.
The native fixture uses a deliberately generous test payload envelope to verify authority transport, not a complete production memory estimator.
The new admitted numerical matrix is replicated text across three weight-residency strategies; existing composite/parallel regressions do not prove complete distributed budget integration.
Media, speculative proposals, dynamic constraints, observations, snapshots and complete materialization/existing-residency inventory require enclosing accounting and integration.
Sequence-output consumers retain their separate SessionPrefill multi-output contract; the ordinary gateway rejects incompatible supplied demand.
Managed bounds do not imply total-process guarantees. No new allocator measurements or released-checkpoint comparisons were performed in this handoff change.
Native and architecture linking emits the existing compact-unwind size warning; required builds and final tests succeed.
